summary.headline: Judgment of the Moon and Jupiter
summary.text: Horary astrological judgment concerning a dead man represented by the eighth house, Jupiter in Taurus in Venus’s house, reception and separation, and a void-of-course Moon separating from Venus. The astrologer compares their angular positions, sign degrees, and speed before transferring the Moon to the second sign from its place.
